Boise River and Floodplain

The Boise River

Nestled alongside the majestic Boise River, Garden City enjoys a unique and dynamic relationship with its natural environment. The river isn't just a scenic backdrop; it's a vital artery that has shaped our community's landscape and character. This section explores the intricate dance between the Boise River and its floodplain, delving into what makes this area so special, the ecological importance of these lands, and how understanding the river's behavior is crucial for the safety and well-being of our residents and businesses. From recreational opportunities to responsible land use, discover how Garden City thrives in harmony with this powerful and beautiful natural resource.
